digo: Mtunda hofu; Muasumini wa tsakani (also written Muasmini wa tsakani)
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. V, App. VI

teaser.en: The forest's own jasmine: the wild cousin of the scented flowers women wear in their hair.
teaser.sw: Asmini ya msituni yenyewe: binamu wa porini wa maua yenye harufu nzuri ambayo wanawake huvaa nywele zao.

summary.en: Mtunda hofu is a wild jasmine of the coastal bush, also called Muasumini wa tsakani, 'jasmine of the forest'. It is the wild form of the cultivated jasmine whose flowers are used for decoration.
summary.sw: Mtunda hofu ni asmini ya porini ya vichaka vya pwani, inayoitwa pia Muasumini wa tsakani, 'asmini ya msituni'. Ni aina ya porini ya mwasmini unaopandwa, ambao maua yake hutumika kama mapambo.

about.en: Mtunda hofu is a scrambling or climbing shrub with opposite leaves, each made of three leaflets, the end one larger. It produces starry white, sweetly scented flowers with a long, narrow tube and five to nine spreading lobes, followed by small, shiny black berries, often in pairs. The Digo identify it by its leaves and flowers.
about.sw: Mtunda hofu ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, chenye majani yanayokabiliana, kila jani likiwa na vijani vitatu, kile cha mwisho kikiwa kikubwa zaidi. Hutoa maua meupe kama nyota yenye harufu tamu, yenye mrija mrefu mwembamba na pindo tano hadi tisa zilizotandaa, yakifuatwa na beri ndogo nyeusi zinazong'aa, mara nyingi jozi jozi. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na maua yake.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and forest edges, scrambling over other shrubs.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, vichaka-mwitu vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani, ukitambaa juu ya vichaka vingine.

culture.en: Its second name links it to the cultivated jasmine, asmini or muasumini, whose flower rosettes Pakia records as decorations worn on clothes and heads or laid on beds, for their beauty and fragrance. Such adornments belong to the Digo idea of maruwa, beauty. Pakia also notes that muasumini is a word borrowed from Swahili.
culture.sw: Jina lake la pili linauhusisha na asmini inayopandwa, asmini au muasumini, ambayo vishada vya maua yake Pakia anavirekodi kama mapambo yanayovaliwa kwenye nguo na vichwani au kutandazwa vitandani, kwa uzuri na harufu yake. Mapambo kama haya ni sehemu ya dhana ya Kidigo ya maruwa, urembo. Pakia pia anaeleza kwamba muasumini ni neno lililotoholewa kutoka Kiswahili.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names. Mtunda hofu is given without a meaning. Muasumini wa tsakani, written Muasmini wa tsakani in Appendix VI, means 'jasmine in the forest', the wild form of the grown perfume plant Muasumini. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Jasminum meyeri-johannis.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo. Mtunda hofu limetolewa bila maana. Muasumini wa tsakani, linaloandikwa Muasmini wa tsakani katika Kiambatisho VI, lina maana ya 'asmini msituni', aina ya porini ya mmea wa manukato unaopandwa, Muasumini. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Jasminum meyeri-johannis.

reason.en: Another flower worn for its fragrance
reason.sw: Ua jingine linalovaliwa kwa harufu yake nzuri

reason.en: Another 'of the forest' wild form of a grown plant
reason.sw: Aina nyingine ya porini ya mmea unaopandwa, yenye 'wa msituni'
